articles.summary: Complete enterprise analytics and AI recoverable on one unified platform Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announced extended Google Cloud data protection to include Google Cloud Storage, and the general availability of agentless, immutable backup for Google BigQuery. As agents move from pilots to production, BigQuery is no longer just a warehouse. It’s the layer agents reason over and act on, making it critical for organizations to secure. The threat to cloud infrastructure is escalating rapidly. A Rubrik Zero Labs report reveals 90% of global IT and security executives reported cyberattacks, with cloud or software-as-a-service environments accounting for 28% of those breaches. Even more alarming, 74% noted threat actors successfully compromised backup and recovery systems. Relying solely on native short-term snapshots leaves organizations vulnerable to credential theft. articles.summary: New detection, investigation, and recovery capabilities enable resilience for critical data Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announced cyber recovery capabilities for DevOps platforms Microsoft Azure DevOps and GitHub. articles.summary: New hosted offering removes hardware barriers to bring clean recovery and cyber resilience to enterprise NAS Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, announced today Rubrik-Hosted Protection for On-Premise Unstructured Data. The offering is built on Rubrik’s Network Attached Storage (NAS) Cloud Direct service. Customers now have clean recovery for enterprise-scale NAS data without having to buy, build or manage backup storage. "Backups mean nothing if you can’t be confident in a clean recovery, and hardware limitations shouldn’t stand between an enterprise and its resilience,” said Anneka Gupta, Chief Product Officer, Rubrik. “By taking on backup storage and orchestration directly in our cloud, Rubrik reduces infrastructure friction so organizations can protect business-critical NAS systems across vendors under one unified policy."
